layerB.label: Published coefficients: Hajat et al. 2005 (Epidemiology 16:613–620)
layerB.citation: Hajat S, Armstrong BG, Gouveia N, Wilkinson P. Mortality displacement of heat-related deaths: a comparison of Delhi, São Paulo, and London. Epidemiology. 2005;16(5):613–620.

values.exposure_metric_as_stated: daily ambient temperature (abstract: 'daily mortality data in relation to daily ambient temperature')
values.lag_note: cumulative effect summed over lags 0–27, net of mortality displacement

mapping.description: daily mean air temperature ≈ a × daily max WBGT + b, fitted on ERA5 Mar–Jun 2015–2022; daily mean taken as (Tmax + Tmin) / 2

layerB.note: RR is relative to a day at or below the 20 °C threshold and includes the 28-day cumulative effect (net of mortality displacement) reported by the study.

secondary.citation: de Bont J, Nori-Sarma A, Stafoggia M, et al. Impact of heatwaves on all-cause mortality in India: A comprehensive multi-city study. Environment International. 2024;184:108461.

values.heatwave_definition: daily mean temperature above the city's 97th annual percentile on 2 consecutive days; pooled over 10 cities

layerC.level_achieved: ward (11 ward-parts of New Delhi district, Census 2011)

source.table: DDW_PCA0705 Primary Census Abstract, town/village/ward level, NCT of Delhi, District New Delhi, 2011
source.publisher: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India

not_available: elderly share (age tables are district-level only)
layerC.pilot_wards: The dashboard's 6 pilot wards are not census wards; no boundaries are available to overlay them, so their relative vulnerability stays simulated.

inputs.baseline_source: 284 deaths/day, Delhi 2011–2018 (de Bont et al. 2024, Table 1) ÷ NCT of Delhi population 16,787,941 (Census 2011)
inputs.population_source: Census 2011 residents of the Connaught Place + Parliament Street sub-districts
inputs.vulnerability_anchor_source: Connaught Place sub-district HVI ÷ New Delhi district mean HVI (Census 2011, Layer C)

real: baseline death rate (de Bont et al. 2024; Census 2011)
pilot population total and vulnerability anchor (Census 2011)
simulated: split of the population across the 6 dashboard wards
assumption: linear scaling of risk with the vulnerability index
daily mean air temperature mapped from WBGT (residual error not propagated)

risk_engine.interpretation: Deaths attributable to each day's heat exposure, cumulated over the following 28 days (the study's lag window), relative to days at or below 20 °C. Residents only; the large daytime commuter population is not counted.
